data.title: Player should be a shape that shows direction

data.author: Map
data.comment: Auto-completed: this work item is a duplicate of already-completed work. The feature 'Player should be a shape that shows direction' was fully implemented and shipped in v0.1.1 under **Direction-neutral ship shape: circle with engines at top, bottom, and each side (AH-0MTAF76Q1008BLBE)**. The Player ship now renders a direction-neutral hexagon hull with per-engine flames that show thrust direction (both 4-directional and asteroids schemes). No further action needed.
